en.title: Google Avoids Business Breakup Despite Ad Tech Monopoly Ruling
en.hook: Google has been found to have a monopoly in ad tech, but managed to dodge a forced corporate breakup.
key_takeaways: Google ruled to hold an illegal monopoly in the ad tech market antitrust lawsuit
Successfully avoided the worst-case scenario of a forced business breakup amid big tech regulations
Expected to heavily influence the future regulatory landscape of digital advertising

zh.title: 谷歌虽被判广告技术垄断，但成功避免业务拆分
zh.hook: 谷歌在反垄断诉讼中被裁定广告技术构成垄断，但避免了最严厉的强制拆分业务判决。
key_takeaways: 谷歌在广告科技反垄断诉讼中被判构成垄断

预计将对未来数字广告市场的监管走向产生深远影响
